author.bio_short: Justin Borges is the founder of The Answer Engine, a company that helps local businesses get recommended by AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. With a background in real estate and digital marketing, Justin developed the AERO-10 methodology for measuring and improving AI search visibility.
